name: review-deck
title: Review Deck
description: Work through a stack of yes/no decisions one card at a time, with a third "later" exit. Drag, button or key; async saves with retry; caller-owned queue and undo.

meta.intent: Work through a stack of yes-or-no decisions quickly, with a way to put one off for later.

docs: Give the deck's parent an explicit height. Exports ReviewDeck, createReviewActions and classifyGesture.
